fields.title: Spotify playlist track record
fields.description: Dataset envelope (_input / _source / _scrapedAt / recordType) on top of Spotify's own playlist and track data. One TRACK row per song, one PLAYLIST row per playlist, ERROR rows on failure. Spotify adds and removes fields without notice, so unlisted fields pass through rather than failing the run.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The URL or id that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: pathfinder-fetchPlaylist, pathfinder-getTrack, or none on failure rows.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was emitted.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Failure rows only: unparsable_input, not_found, unsupported_entity or fetch_failed.

position.title: Position
position.description: 1-based position of the track within its playlist.

trackName.title: Track name
trackName.description: Song title exactly as Spotify shows it, version suffixes included.

artistNames.title: All artists
artistNames.description: Every credited artist, in Spotify's own order.

artists.title: Artist references
artists.description: Each credited artist as name, id, URI and open.spotify.com URL.

albumName.title: Album
albumName.description: Album or single this recording belongs to.

releaseDate.title: Release date
releaseDate.description: Album release date, ISO 8601. Precision can be year-only for older catalogue.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: Track length as m:ss, or h:mm:ss when it runs past an hour.

playcount.title: Play count
playcount.description: Spotify's lifetime stream count for this recording. Has no equivalent in Spotify's official API, which only publishes a relative popularity score.

popularity.title: Popularity (0-100)
popularity.description: Spotify's relative popularity score. Present only when ISRC enrichment ran.

isrc.title: ISRC
isrc.description: International Standard Recording Code. Present only when ISRC enrichment ran.

isrcLookup.title: ISRC lookup outcome
isrcLookup.description: How the ISRC was obtained: exact (same recording id), title-artist (same title and artist, possibly a different release), disabled, not-attempted, no-match, no-title, search-failed or skipped-quota.

previewUrl.title: Audio preview
previewUrl.description: 30-second MP3 preview URL, when Spotify publishes one for this market.

explicit.title: Explicit
explicit.description: True when Spotify labels the recording explicit.

discNumber.title: Disc number
discNumber.description: Disc the track sits on within its album.

trackNumber.title: Track number
trackNumber.description: Position of the track within its album.

playable.title: Playable
playable.description: Whether Spotify reports the recording as playable in the requested market.

trackUri.title: Track URI
trackUri.description: spotify:track: URI, the form Spotify's own tools accept.

coverArt.title: Cover art
coverArt.description: Largest album cover image Spotify offers.

addedAt.title: Added to playlist
addedAt.description: Date the track was added to the playlist.

label.title: Record label
label.description: Phonographic copyright line, which names the label. Individually requested tracks only.

copyright.title: Copyright lines
copyright.description: Full composition and recording copyright notices. Individually requested tracks only.

playlistName.title: Playlist name
playlistName.description: Name of the playlist this track came from.

description.title: Playlist description
description.description: PLAYLIST rows: the curator's description, HTML stripped.

followers.title: Playlist followers
followers.description: PLAYLIST rows: how many accounts follow the playlist.

trackCount.title: Playlist size
trackCount.description: PLAYLIST rows: total tracks in the playlist, which can exceed the number scraped.

ownerName.title: Owner
ownerName.description: Display name of the account that owns the playlist.

ownerId.title: Owner id
ownerId.description: Spotify user id of the owner.

ownerUrl.title: Owner URL
ownerUrl.description: open.spotify.com profile link for the owner.

isEditorialChart.title: Editorial chart
isEditorialChart.description: PLAYLIST rows: true for Spotify's own ranked playlists, which carry the extra chart fields below.

lastUpdated.title: Chart last updated
lastUpdated.description: Editorial charts only: when Spotify last recalculated the ranking.

rankType.title: Ranking basis
rankType.description: Editorial charts only: what the ranking counts, for example plays.

newEntriesCount.title: New entries
newEntriesCount.description: Editorial charts only: how many tracks are new since the previous edition.

shareUrl.title: Share URL
shareUrl.description: Spotify's own share link, including its si tracking parameter.
